My memory doesn't hold that answer. It records only that you pasted the sudo password once so I could raise the inotify limit with sysctl, and that you were told to rotate it. It doesn't say which file I wrote, whether the change was persisted for reboots, or what value I set. I won't guess.

To check on obelisk, look at `/etc/sysctl.d/` and `/etc/sysctl.conf` for a `fs.inotify.max_user_watches` line. `sysctl fs.inotify.max_user_watches` shows the live value. I can dispatch a leaf to check if you want.
